name: longmaytrai
rule: Upper hair/forehead boundary, five equally spaced points, outer tail (0) to inner head (4).

name: longmayphai
rule: Upper hair/forehead boundary, five equally spaced points, inner head (5) to outer tail (9).

name: songmui
rule: Three equal intervals down bridge. 10 is the depression between eyes level with inner canthi. 13 is the foot of the bridge above nostrils, short of the nose tip.

name: mattrai
rule: Start at outside corner 14, follow upper lid margin through 15–17 to inner corner 18, return along lower lid 19–21. Sample at 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 width.

name: matphai
rule: Start at inner corner 22, upper lid 23–25, outer corner 26, return on lower lid 27–29 at corresponding quarter positions.

name: moingoai
rule: Follow red lip to skin boundary. Left/right corners 30/36, middle 33/39. Upper points 31–35 at 0.18, 0.36, 0.50, 0.66, 0.84 of width. Return along bottom with five equally spaced points 37–41.

name: moitrong
rule: Inside outer lip. Follow lip/opening boundary, not teeth or tongue. Corners 42/46; place central points 44/48 first, then upper 43–45 and lower 47–49 at quarter-width positions. Retain all 8 along seam of a closed mouth.
